nodes.text: Cambodia, Malaysia, and India have acknowledged HMPV following after an outbreak in China. Patients claim it's worse than Covid. Mortality among children is high. It's obviously life-threatening. It's H1N1 others' claim. Remember, the Communist Party of China hid Covid-19.
